@@ -50,3 +50,0 @@ - * The {@link #finalize()} method of a value class will never be invoked by - * the garbage collector. - *

@@ -601,2 +598,1 @@ - * It is illegal for a value class, abstract or concrete, to declare - * a {@code finalize} method. + * Value class, abstract or concrete, cannot have {@code finalize} methods.
